apps.name: Splitter
apps.subtitle: Speedrun timer powered by livesplit-core
apps.localizedDescription:
A native speedrun timer for iPhone and iPad, built on livesplit-core.

• Imports Splitter .split files, LiveSplit .lss and Splits.io .json
• Big Start/Split button with haptics, plus Undo, Skip, Pause and Reset
• Ahead/behind and gold-segment colours, comparisons, Real/Game time
• Edit splits on the device; runs autosave as .lss in the Files app
